The **Quick Shortcuts Dock** provides instant one-click access to 8 essential hospital operational tools:

1. 📞 **Intercom Hotline**: Live campus telephony directory & direct dial
2. 🕒 **24h Duty**: Daily 24-hour consultant and resident clinical roster (PDF)
3. 🩸 **Blood Bank**: Live real-time blood components and units stock (PDF)
4. 📧 **Email List**: Official hospital and college staff email directory (PDF)
5. 📖 **Abbreviation**: Approved medical & clinical abbreviations guide (PDF)
6. 💳 **Billing**: Inpatient & outpatient billing operational manual (PDF)
7. 🩺 **Nursing**: Ward procedures, medication safety & nursing user manual (PDF)
8. 🔄 **Replace PDF**: Administrative server for intranet document updates & uploads.
